uses: retrospective aggregate safety and identity audit only
limitations: No individual patient dose/exposure/follow-up to receptor-peptide mapping
All-cause mortality is not treatment-caused mortality
AE occurrence does not establish molecular off-target causality
Unreported events and absent rows do not mean zero risk
No synthetic safe negative for a peptide or TCR
Do not sum counts across overlapping trials or event categories
Anti-CD3 soluble TCR bispecific and TCR-T mechanisms must be stratified
